results.note: Catalogus alter pontificum Romanorum: no English translation found despite searches for papal catalogs and related works. Related papal histories exist (Liber Pontificalis, Regesta Pontificum) but not this specific anonymous catalog.
Catalogus episcoporum Romanorum: no English translation found. Searches for episcopal catalogs and related papal documents yielded no results for this work.
Catalogus imperatorum: no English translation found. This catalog of emperors was not found in translation searches.
Catalogus pontificum Romanorum et decretorum: no English translation found. Related papal and decree collections exist but not this specific work.
Catalogus pontificum Romanorum: no English translation found. Similar catalogs of popes exist but not this specific version.
Catalogus summorum pontificum: no English translation found despite searches for papal lists and catalogs.
Depositio episcoporum: no English translation found. This episcopal burial list from the Chronography of 354 appears only in Latin sources.
Depositio martyrum: no English translation found. Related martyrologies exist (e.g., Roman Martyrology) but not this specific deposition/burial list.
Descriptio coemeteriorum SS. Martyrum: no English translation found. Related medieval pilgrim guides to Rome's catacombs exist (De locis sanctis martyrum) but not this specific work.
Descriptio regionum urbis: no English translation found. Medieval descriptions of Rome's regions exist but not this specific anonymous work.
Nomina pontificum Romanorum per ordinem: no English translation found. Various lists of popes exist but not this specific catalog.
Fragmentum Catalogi pontificalis: no English translation found. Related papal catalogs (e.g., Fragmentum Laurentianum) appear in scholarly works but no standalone English translation.
Vitae pontificum Romanorum: no English translation found. This medieval papal lives collection is distinct from Donizo's Vita Mathildis or other papal biographies. Searches found no English version.
De antiquis episcoporum promotionibus: no English translation found despite searches for early church episcopal practices and ordination.

De computo: no English translation found. While Helperic of Auxerre and Bede's computus works are translated, this large 37,647-word compilation (possibly a broader compendium) has no identified English translation.
Excerptum de conversione Carentanorum: no English translation found. While related Conversio Bagoariorum et Carantanorum is translated, this excerpt is not.
Fragmentum ex Historia de conversione Boiorum et Carentanorum: no English translation found. Related works on Bavarian and Carantanian conversion exist but not this fragment.
Historia translationis corporis S. Cornelii: no English translation found. Medieval relic translation narratives exist but not this specific work.
Homilia de decimis et de jejunio: no English translation found. Medieval homilies on tithes and fasting are referenced but not this specific sermon.

Invectiva pro Formoso papa: complete English translation available online. 'Invectiva in Romam pro Formoso papa, by Anonymous (circa 914) - A Complete English Translation' by A Phuulish Fellow (blog), 2025. Also in Documenta Catholica Omnia.
Narratio de monacho Cenomanensi: no English translation found. This 9th-century narrative about a monk from Le Mans converting to canonical life appears only in Latin (PL 129 and Mansi).
Continuatio Chronici: no English translation found. Medieval chronicle continuations (e.g., Continuatio Eulogii) have translations but not this specific work.
Sermo in natali S. Odonis: no English translation found. While works by Odo of Cluny are translated, this specific sermon on his nativity was not found.
Litania in honorem S. Eusebii: no English translation found. Medieval litanies (e.g., Litany of the Saints) have translations but not this specific litany to St. Eusebius.
Nomina plebium episcopatus S. Eusebii: no English translation found. This list of parishes in the episcopate of St. Eusebius appears only in Latin sources.
Officium S. Udalrici: no English translation found. While hymns and liturgical texts related to St. Ulrich of Augsburg are referenced, no complete English Office was found.

Vita S. Mathildis: English translations exist of Donizo of Canossa's Vita Mathildis. Multiple translations of portions published on Academia.edu and scholarly works. Full translation by Andrew Rabin in 'The Political Writings of Archbishop Wulfstan of York' (Manchester, 2015) provides related contemporary context.
Rhythmica antiqua Veronae: no English translation found. Likely related to Versus de Verona (Carolingian poem) but no English translation identified.
Sermo in festo SS. Firmi et Rustici: no English translation found. Sermon attributed to Ratherius of Verona; Latin text available on Wikisource but no English translation.
Appendix ad translationem corporis S. Hunegundis: no English translation found. Related to 10th-century translation of St. Hunegund's relics but no English text identified.
Acclamationes: no English translation found. Medieval acclamations (ceremonial shouts/expressions) are documented but this specific collection was not identified.
Benedicito puerperae secundum usum Aethiopum: no English translation found. Ethiopian benediction for childbirth; medieval blessing formulas exist but not this specific work.
Benedictio armorum: no English translation found. Medieval blessing of arms exists in ecclesiastical sources but no English translation identified.
Benedictio cereorum: no English translation found. Medieval blessing of candles/wax documented in liturgical sources but not translated to English.
Benedictio cinerum: no English translation found. Blessing of ashes (Ash Wednesday) documented but not this specific medieval formulation.
Benedictio olei: no English translation found. Medieval blessing of oil for baptism/confirmation/sick documented but not this specific work.
Benedictio palmarum: no English translation found. Medieval blessing of palms (Palm Sunday) documented but not this specific version.
Benedictio reginae: no English translation found. Medieval blessing of queens documented but not this specific text.
Benedictio salis et aquae: no English translation found. Medieval blessing of salt and water documented but not this specific formulation.
Benedictiones consecrationes et ordinationes variae: no English translation found. Various medieval blessings, consecrations, and ordinations documented but not this compilation.
Benedictiones variae: no English translation found. Various medieval blessings documented but not this specific collection.

Canones editi sub Edgardo rege: English translations exist. Andrew Rabin, 'The Political Writings of Archbishop Wulfstan of York' (Manchester University Press, 2015), pp. 85-100. Also Benjamin Thorpe, 'Ancient laws and institutes of England' (1840), pp. 395-402.

Canonum prisca collectio: no English translation found. Early collection of church council canons; while Dionysius Exiguus's translations are known, this specific ancient collection has no identified English translation.
Carmen de monasterio Gemmeticensi: no English translation found. This medieval poem about the Abbey of Jumièges is documented but not translated to English.
Coronatio Arnulfi: no English translation found. While Arnulf of Carinthia's coronation in 896 is well-documented historically, this specific text was not identified in translation.
